body: Orchestrator note (attempt 3): the orchestrator kernel restarted right after this claim and the claim token was lost before dispatch. Attempts 1 and 2 were already freed with fail_attempt for the same cause (token read from the wrong response field), so failing attempt 3 would use the last try. Instead a worker is dispatched now on the pinned ticket content in its own worktree; when the lease expires, the orchestrator inspects the worktree and reconciles attempt 3 with `resubmit` and the worker's outputs and evidence, or `abandon` if the work did not finish.
